name: Firearms and weapons
what: Hold a licence or permit from the state police to deal in firearms or prohibited weapons, or to run a paintball venue.
consistency_note: Each state and territory licenses dealers and venues under its own firearms and weapons laws.

basis.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
basis.quote: A person must not— (a) carry on activities as a firearms dealer, or (b) possess a firearm in the person's capacity as a firearms dealer, unless authorised to do so by a firearms dealer licence.

basis.publisher: SA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
basis.quote: A person who carries on the business of a dealer in South Australia without holding a firearms licence authorising the person to carry on that business is guilty of an offence

basis.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
basis.quote: A person must not, in carrying on a business as a weapons dealer, buy, sell or manufacture any prohibited weapon unless authorised to do so by a weapons dealer permit.
